hooks.name: Ledger property tests
hooks.description: When ledger code changes, run the ledger tests; on a property-test failure, fix the bug, add the counterexample as a regression test, and log it.

action.prompt: Run `npm test -- tests/ledger`. If a property test fails, show the shrunk counterexample, explain the bug, fix it, add the counterexample as a named regression test, and add a line to docs/KIRO_LOG.md under Property-based testing.
